initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table establishes an observed risk difference of 0.10. The verification checks confirm arithmetic, but supply no causal identification evidence. Request archived design record R214-1 to assess whether the average causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 24/60 − 27/90 = 0.10. R214-1 supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the causal effect. The population table and arithmetic checks therefore do not uniquely determine E[Y(1)] − E[Y(0)].
